description: Native desktop UI components for Go, built on MyGo. Themed controls, window shells, Lucide icons, plus chat, Markdown, code highlighting, charts and a command palette. Also includes a standalone packager for macOS, Windows and Linux.
summary: Onevra gives you a native Go desktop UI without reaching for Electron or a webview, which is exactly the local-first, low-toil path I want for anything that needs to run on a machine and stay observable. The conversation component with tool activity, folded summaries, and attachment input is basically a ready-made shell for an agent-session viewer, the desktop version of what I'm doing with PenguPool and AgentOn Pocket. The design stance of refining MyGo's built-ins, filling only the gaps, and deferring to upstream when they catch up is the kind of restraint that keeps a dependency surface small and auditable.
